This issue might be a duplicate of existing issues. Please check:
- #31051: Requests emitting `tui.session.select` on in-TUI session navigation — same root problem (TUI route changes not published to the event bus, so plugins can't detect session switches). The proposed solution here introduces two new events (`tui.session.focused` / `tui.session.unfocused`) while #31051 proposes reusing the existing `tui.session.select` event, but both address the same gap.
